name: whatsapp-mcp
description: Read, search and summarise your own WhatsApp chats. Read-only unless you turn on sending.
long_description: Links to your own WhatsApp as a linked device (like WhatsApp Web) and runs entirely on your Mac: your session and messages stay on this computer. Ask Claude to "connect WhatsApp" to link your phone with a code. Sending messages and group admin are off by default; turn them on in this extension's settings, ideally with an allowlist. Unofficial: never use it to bulk-send.

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.description: Which chats were busy since a time

allow_write.title: Allow sending and group admin
allow_write.description: Off: Claude can only read. On: Claude can send messages and files, and manage groups you admin, on your real account. You approve each action.

send_allowlist.title: Only allow writes to these chats
send_allowlist.description: Comma-separated phone numbers with country code, or group JIDs. Leave empty for no restriction. Strongly recommended when sending is on.

media_dir.title: Only send files from this folder
media_dir.description: Optional full folder path, e.g. /Users/you/WhatsAppOutbox. Leave empty to allow any file.
